ai.title: Version 0.0.112 for freebuff CLI release package
ai.summary: The `freebuff` CLI release package version bumps from 0.0.111 to 0.0.112. This update applies to `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`.

eli5.text: Updating to version 0.0.112 means the assistant's command-line tool now shows a clearer reset countdown on the model selector, adds a "Press Enter" hint on the recommended model row, and emits a MESSAGE_SENT analytics event for daily active user tracking. The underlying tool runtime was also upgraded from Bun 1.3.11 to 1.3.14, improving stability. These changes take effect when you install or update the CLI package today.

facts: [Freebuff](https://www.npmjs.com/package/freebuff)** is the free, ad-supported version of Codebuff. No subscription. No credits. No configuration. Just install and start coding in your terminal.

What models do you use?** The best open-source models available. In full mode you can choose from DeepSeek V4 Pro, MiMo 2.5 Pro, Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiMo 2.5, and MiniMax M3. Limited mode uses DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiMo 2.5. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite handles file finding and research.

Which countries is Freebuff available in?** All countries. Freebuff runs in "full" mode in the US, Canada, UK, EU, and other select countries, and in "limited" mode everywhere else (or while using a VPN). See [freebuff.com](https://freebuff.com) for the full list.
What is limited mode?** Limited mode lets you use Freebuff outside the full-access countries, or while using a VPN. It includes DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiMo 2.5, with 5 one-hour sessions per day.
What data do you store?** We don't store your codebase. We only collect minimal logs for debugging purposes.

ai.summary: Documentation restructured to establish root `README.md` as single source of truth, with `freebuff/README.md` now linking to it. eli5.text: If you install or update the free coding assistant Freebuff, its help documentation now lives in one central place instead of being spread across multiple files, the main guide points you to the single source, and the other files just link to it. The model information is also refreshed to show which AI engines are available in full mode (DeepSeek V4 Pro, MiMo 2.5 Pro, Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiMo 2.5, and MiniMax M3) versus limited mode (DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiMo 2.5), and the release notes now clarify that Freebuff is supported by text ads and that labeled models may be used for training data.

entries.title: CLI update: command-registry

ai.title: /plan and /review run on selected model, ChatGPT gate removed
ai.summary: Removed the mandatory ChatGPT connection gate for /plan and /review commands. These commands now default to the user's currently selected model for deep-thinking steps, delegating to @thinker-gpt only when a ChatGPT account is connected via /connect. Updated `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` to drop the connection check, `cli/src/commands/prompt-builders.ts` to conditionally select prompt variants, and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts` to remove 'Connect required' prefixes and generic descriptions.

eli5.text: When you use /plan or /review, it now runs on the model you have selected instead of forcing you to connect a ChatGPT account first. If you have connected ChatGPT via /connect, those commands still delegate the deep-thinking step to the GPT model as they used to; otherwise your selected model handles the work directly. The prompts that /plan and /review send are chosen automatically based on whether you have ChatGPT connected, so you do not see a 'connect required' message anymore. The tips shown in the help banner now suggest trying the full '/interview then /plan then implement' workflow regardless of whether you have connected ChatGPT.
